integrity: The numerical conclusions follow from the normal bundle Chern-class formula, weak Lefschetz, and the topological Lefschetz formula applied to the cited canonical-cover involution.
scientific_limitations: Requires a smooth complete intersection of three quadrics in P^6 over C and an involution with exactly eight isolated fixed points.
Determines eigenspace dimensions and an isogeny decomposition only, not the factors' isomorphism classes, polarization types, endomorphism rings, or simplicity.
The fixed-point construction is a literature premise; independent validation has not been performed.
title: The canonical-cover involution splits the intermediate Jacobian in dimensions six and eight
